title: fix(runtime)!: the action route answers by who holds the name on the route, and the environment address answers its own item
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-elon-musk"} -->
_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D1TU5kbi4P8cud1uUdYQYCs)_
Fixes #32996
Fixes #32995
Fixes #32989
Fixes #32988

Clause-②: yes (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: none — no skill under `skills/**` teaches how the `/actions` route answers when several holders (packages, a disabled package, the environment, the platform) share an action name.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:`/actions/:object/NAME` 裸路由在同名动作有多个持有者时,改为只看「谁在本路由上持有该名」来回答;`/actions/_env/:object/NAME` 在有包同名时也能答出环境自己的动作。
- 为什么改:原答案取决于别处有几个启用的持有者和注册先后(#32996、#32989),`_env` 精确地址在包同名时答 404(#32988);另修 #32995 的引文与不可观测措辞。
- 风险与回滚:收窄一格(禁用包占本路由时环境项不再被服务,原先仅「别处恰一个启用持有者」时被服务),其余为放宽;回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`packages/runtime/src/action-execution.ts` 的 `routeHolderCensus` 与 `readRouteHolders`、`resolveAddressedRouteActionDeclaration` 的 404 分支;然后是 `action-package-addressing.test.ts` 新增 describe。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime exec vitest run --project local src/action-package-addressing.test.ts`,预期全部通过。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

The bare route `/actions/:object/NAME` (no package named) used to take its declaration from the protocol's bare by-name read. That read cannot see the routed object, so when the name has a package holder beside a package-less item (the environment's own, or the platform's) or beside a disabled package, its answer depended on who else held the name and on registration order. The route now decides those compositions from **who holds the name on the route**: the items bound to the routed object, else the object-less ones, read from the registry's listing of every holder (disabled packages included) and the environment's own store (`readRouteHolders`, `routeHolderCensus`):

1. no served package's action owns the route and a disabled package's does: no declaration (main's own answer beside the environment's item, now the answer whatever other holders the name has);
2. the environment's own item on the route's first rung: that item, no package (ADR-0150 D3, environment first on one owner key);
3. exactly one served package on the route's first rung and no platform item there: that package's own declaration, read at its exact address and served with no package (unqualified dispatch, as before);
4. anything else: the bare read answers, as before.

The environment's exact address `/actions/_env/:object/NAME` answers the environment's own item from the same reading when the merged listing omits it (it folds a package-less item into a stand-in for a package holder), whatever the other holders. `environmentOwnerOfUnheldRoute` (#32751) now reads through the same reader; its docblock no longer cites ruling 6824698376 letter A for the disabled-holder answer and grounds it in main's own answer (#32995 item 1).

Moved answers, measured with a probe on BASE (`e540baf8`) and on this head, each cell in both registration orders:

| Composition | Route | FROM | TO |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| env item on `lead`, disabled D on `lead` (or object-less), one enabled holder elsewhere | `/actions/lead/NAME` | env's item | no declaration (narrowing; 0 and 2 enabled holders elsewhere already answered no declaration) |
| env item on `lead` or object-less, served B on `contact`, disabled A object-less | `/actions/lead/NAME` | env's item when A registered after B, no declaration when before | no declaration (narrowing) |
| served B on `contact`, env item on `lead` or object-less, with or without a disabled co-holder A | `/actions/contact/NAME` | no declaration, or env's object-less item (order-dependent) | B's own declaration |
| served B on `contact`, platform item on `lead` | `/actions/contact/NAME` | no declaration | B's own declaration |
| served A on `account`, disabled D and platform item on `lead` | `/actions/account/NAME` | no declaration | A's own declaration |
| env item on `contact`, served B on `contact`, disabled A registered before B | `/actions/contact/NAME` | no declaration | env's item (as when A registered after B, or is absent) |
| env item on `lead` or object-less, served B on `contact`, disabled A on another object registered before B | `/actions/lead/NAME` | no declaration | env's item (as in the other order) |
| env item on `lead` (or object-less), one or two package holders elsewhere | `/actions/_env/lead/NAME` | `404` | env's own item, no package |

Unchanged: one holder alone; two served packages on the route's key (refused naming both); the platform's item on the routed object (bare read's answer); every caller that names its package; every route on a host whose registry cannot list every holder or whose engine has no store.

Not fixed here, needs a decision (#32996 item 2): the registry keeps ONE package-less item per name, so a platform item bound to `lead` and the environment's object-less item replace each other and the later registration stays. With two package holders elsewhere, `lead` answers the environment's object-less item when the environment registered last, and no declaration when the platform did; the `lead`-bound handler runs in both. In the environment-last order the platform item is gone from the registry, so the route cannot see it; making both orders answer alike needs the registry to keep both (`packages/objectql/src/registry.ts`, out of this area's surface).

#32995 item 3: the clause "an item bound to `lead` comes before one with no object" landed in the released `packages/runtime/CHANGELOG.md` entry for 6aa658a. Release-owned, so not edited in this code PR; the new docblock of `readRouteHolders` says why it is unobservable (one package-less slot per name), and the correction of the released entry is owed as a docs-only PR.

## Tests

Pins in `packages/runtime/src/action-package-addressing.test.ts`, every cell in both registration orders; ablations and gate readings in the report comment on #32996 (`os-dev-report`).

## Acceptance notes

- The protocol's bare by-name read stamps the environment's package-less item with a package holder's `_packageId`, and its answer beside a disabled package moves with registration order. Both live in `packages/metadata-protocol` (area E1); the route no longer depends on them for these compositions.

## Verification

Readings follow in the `os-dev-report` comment on #32996; this body is the seat's to bring to the final head.

_Head `b30e9bb4` adds review#3's M1 fix: the route's composition guards run on the listing before any store read; pinned with zero store reads and no degrade for a one-holder name when the store throws._
